description: This file defines the `RandomPlacement` class, which implements a placement strategy for efficiently placing new grain activations on random compatible servers within the Orleans runtime. It contains a singleton instance and is part of the placement strategies in the Orleans core abstractions.

classes.name: RandomPlacement
classes.description: A placement strategy that randomly assigns new grain activations to available servers, ensuring load distribution.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: A singleton property providing a shared instance of the RandomPlacement strategy.
